reviewContext.issueReference: none; runtime workflowInput of opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-826 is authoritative
reviewContext.userProblem: Authors cannot see what a slide will show, because a slide is the page's single frame or else its content bounds. Building the next slide from the previous one needs a way to copy every shape of one page onto another.
requiredOutcomes: Optional Document.slideSize and Page.slideOrigin validate, round-trip in canonical JSONL and Yjs, and are byte-identical when absent.
Pure core resolveSlideRect, presets and slideLabel, with tests.
The presentation controller clips and fits exactly the explicit rect when a size is set; nothing changes when no size is set.
A DOM-only slide-area overlay with a label, and dimming only for an explicit size. It is never exported or hit-tested, and has an optional Canvas prop with automatic visibility.
Inspector settings for the slide size and the page origin.

copyPageElements through a helper extracted from planDuplicatePage, with one undo step and the pasted elements selected; a picker that defaults to Previous page; the page tab menu item and a header action.
The CLI command nodetto-cli pages copy-shapes with --from page|prev|next and --to page.
Docs (editing.md, cli.md) and the README updated.
constraints: Exactly one new core Command kind, updateDocument (design 3.1). It must be stated in the final summary, together with the private sync Worker follow-up.
The overlay never reaches the core renderers, exports, thumbnails or presentation.
The Show slide area toggle is a UI preference only.
Public repository only, gitPush false, no emojis.
designDecisionsAndRationale: updateDocument is needed because Store.meta was load-only and no command could edit document fields (design 3.1, user-qa Q1).
The UI uses editor.apply with the commands, with no facade setters, so the work fits in 2 feature waves (design 3.3).
Core resolvers take structural inputs, so sac-03 runs in parallel with sac-01.
The controller owns explicit-size rendering through SvgExportOptions.viewport (SAC-DES-001).
NodettoCanvasProps.showSlideArea is optional, with automatic visibility, so wave 2 typechecks before wiring (SAC-DES-002).
sac-01 owns the IR barrel type names, because wave 2 imports them.
The desktop app has no Edit/Page menu bar. The design's Edit/Page entry is a FileActions header button next to Present, plus the page tab menu item.
residualRisks: The private sync Worker needs an updateDocument case.
An older collab client can drop slideOrigin when it edits a page.
SlideAreaOverlay and the dialog DOM have no automated DOM test; the logic is covered through the pure modules.
intentionalTradeoffs: Exactly one new core Command kind, updateDocument, because Store.meta had no editing command (design 3.1, user-qa Q1); the private sync Worker needs a matching case, stated in the final summary.
The Edit/Page menu entry is a FileActions header button plus the page tab menu item, because the desktop app has no menu bar.
SlideAreaOverlay and CopyShapesDialog DOM have no automated DOM tests; their logic is covered by the pure modules.
An older collab client can drop Page.slideOrigin when it edits that page (design 10), as accepted for hiddenInPresentation.
sac-01 and sac-08 exceed the ~150-line plan guidance; splitting them would add contract coupling (step5 review residuals).
Strict-index violations are caught at reconcile or in sac-08 through the production-only noUncheckedIndexedAccess gate (SAC-PLAN-001).
supportedEdgeCases: Explicit slide size with and without a page slideOrigin override, including an empty page (the explicit rect still resolves; frames are ignored).
No slide size: unchanged fallback to the single visible frame, else content bounds; an empty page resolves to null.
Hidden pages: the label reads Hidden from presentation; hidden pages count as tab neighbors for prev/next.

Copy shapes: prev at the first page and next at the last page are disabled in the UI and a clear CLI error; source equal to target is rejected; an empty source copies 0 elements with no undo entry and no write.
Copied elements get fresh IDs with connector endpoints, group/frame membership and parent links remapped, the same coordinates, placement above existing target content, and one undo step.
The CLI prev/next keywords win over a page literally named prev or next; --dry-run writes nothing.
Documents without slideSize/slideOrigin round-trip byte-identically; duplicate page output stays byte-identical.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Fit to slide / zoom-to-slide action (deferred, user-qa Q6).
A keyboard shortcut for copy shapes.
Copying page-level fields (name, mode, tokens, routing) or duplicating binary assets.
Changes to slideshow keys or navigation.
Changes to the private nodetto-cloud sync Worker.
